newsitem.title: USA: FSI International backs FY97 $0.30 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: FSI International backs FY97 $0.30 EPS view.

text.p: FSI International Inc said Tuesday analysts' expectations of $0.30 a share earnings for fiscal 1997 ending in August matched the micro-electronics capital equipment maker's expectations.

"That (0.30 earnings per share) is still in line with our internal expectations," FSI chief financial officer Benno Sand told Reuters following a presentation at the Piper Jaffray investors conference here.
Sand said the company still expected to report revenues in the range of $243 million to $258 million. The company reported earnings of $1.22 a share on revenues of $304 million a year ago.

"We've just pre-announced the third quarter being in the $50 million to $53 million (revenue) range," Sand said. "We've said we'll be down 15-20 percent for the year and that's still in line with what we expect to report."
In that same third quarter pre-announcement, the company said sales of about $6 million associated with the delayed shipment of equipment would not be recognized in the third quarter.
Sand said the chances of those orders making it to fourth quarter results were "50-50."
